project: BioGuider benchmark — initial round (10 vignettes × 9 levels × 5 models × 1 prompt)

stories.title: Revise BIOGUIDER_PROMPT per Step 1a
acceptanceCriteria: File system_tests/test_single_file_stress.py contains the literal string 'GROUND TRUTH' inside BIOGUIDER_PROMPT
File system_tests/test_single_file_stress.py contains the literal string 'rewrite the PROSE to match the CODE' inside BIOGUIDER_PROMPT
The line 'Changed numeric values' no longer appears in BIOGUIDER_PROMPT (removes the injection-taxonomy cheat-sheet)
BIOGUIDER_PROMPT ends with 'CORRUPTED DOCUMENT TO FIX:' followed by a newline
poetry run pytest system_tests/test_single_file_stress.py::test_multi_file_full_matrix --collect-only exits 0 (syntax intact)

stories.title: Narrow test_configs to single bioguider prompt per Step 1b
acceptanceCriteria: system_tests/test_single_file_stress.py contains the line 'test_configs = [(m, "bioguider") for m in MODELS]'
grep -c 'for p in ["bioguider", "simple"]' system_tests/test_single_file_stress.py returns 0
Function docstring of test_multi_file_full_matrix references '5 models × 1 prompt' and '450' cells
poetry run pytest system_tests/test_single_file_stress.py::test_multi_file_full_matrix --collect-only exits 0

stories.title: Launch the 450-cell benchmark in background
acceptanceCriteria: Directories logs/ and outputs/multi_file_stress/ exist
/tmp/bench_log.txt contains a path to a file under logs/
The log file referenced exists and pytest has started (banner or test selection line present)
No 401 / no Python traceback in the first 50 lines of the log

stories.title: Abort-check after de_vignette completes
acceptanceCriteria: outputs/multi_file_stress/run_*/de_vignette/STRESS_TEST_RESULTS.json exists
At least one entry in that JSON has f1_score_scorable > 0
outputs/multi_file_stress/run_*/de_vignette/de_vignette.level_5.manifest.json contains at least one error whose category starts with 'prose_code_' or equals 'accession_id_prefix'
If either fails, the pytest pid is killed and diagnostics are appended to the log

stories.title: Full-run completion summary
acceptanceCriteria: outputs/multi_file_stress/run_*/INDEX.md exists
outputs/multi_file_stress/run_*/_aggregate/AGGREGATE_RESULTS.json exists
At least 8 of 10 per-file subdirs contain STRESS_TEST_RESULTS.json
Summary posted to chat with wall-clock, file-success-count, and mean f1_score_scorable across models

constraints: Do NOT git commit during this run. User will review results first.
Do NOT re-enable the simple prompt axis.
Use force_deterministic=True injection (already hard-wired in the test).
